Hi Connor / Jane,

Thanks for the context — happy to validate. High-level checklist for publisher tenancy and technical gating: 

1) Publisher verification: we need either a verified publisher ID in Partner Center or one of the following proofs: a) tenant ID + DNS TXT record proving domain ownership, or b) a signed tenancy letter on corporate letterhead (PDF). From your note, the tenancy letter should be sufficient; please ensure it includes the tenant GUID and the primary contact.

2) Offer payload / manifest: submit the ARM manifest (acme-offer-payload.json) and the package (zip) via Partner Center for automated linting. Key items we check: SKU mapping, OAuth redirect URIs (for SaaS), REST endpoint reachability, and certificate chain for any TLS endpoints. Max package size is 250MB for the initial validation.

3) Co-sell opt-in: to enable co-sell you must opt-in in Partner Center and complete the marketplace intake form (link below). We also need the co-sell SOW if Acme wants Redwood to act as the technical contact — that speeds up the co-sell enablement.

Typical timeline: 3–5 business days for the technical validation once we have the full payload+proof. If there are manifest issues it can add another 2–4 business days depending on fixes.

Action items for you: 
- Attach tenant proof (PDF) and the ARM manifest in Partner Center OR reply to this thread with the files.
- Confirm whether Acme will use a verified publisher ID or if they need Redwood to publish on their behalf.

Partner Center onboarding doc: https://learn.microsoft.com/partner-center/marketplace-onboarding
Marketplace intake form: https://partner.microsoft.com/marketplace/intake-form

Regards,
Priya Kumar
Azure Marketplace Specialist
marketplace-pub@microsoft.com
